fusions.name: Rehearsed Pass
fusions.desc: A snapping strike that reaches an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 7 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at full range, and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Hundredth Lap
fusions.desc: Bites every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 26 damage. Every hit is a critical hit, and the damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Circle Back
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Corrected Approach
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
